milestone.title: Persistent TUI chrome: footer hints + top status bar

intent.outcome: Status bar shows a navigation breadcrumb from the component stack; existing context-sensitive footer and live toggles are preserved and covered by automated render tests.

problem.description: andre already has a context-sensitive footer (per-screen hints + global toggles + narrow fallback in ui/footer.rs) and a status bar with live toggles (ui/status_bar.rs). The remaining gap is a location breadcrumb built from the component stack so the user always sees where they are in navigation. Spec previously treated footer as greenfield — that work is already landed.

in_scope: Breadcrumb from component_stack rendered in render_status_bar (or adjacent chrome).
Wire breadcrumb from ui::render using stack ids/titles.
Automated render tests for breadcrumb and existing footer context line.
Confirm narrow-terminal and theme behavior still hold.
out_of_scope: Rebuilding the footer from scratch (already context-sensitive).

acceptance_criteria.description: Footer still shows key actions for the active component (regression guard on existing behavior)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M02 chrome: breadcrumb from component_stack in status_bar (format_breadcrumb); footer regression tests for major screen families; themes+narrow chrome tests. Evidence: make lint exit 0; cargo test -p andre --test render — 23 passed exit 0. AC-01/02/03 criterion pass stamped.

acceptance_criteria.description: Top status bar shows a breadcrumb that updates when the component stack changes; toggles (v/d/t) still update live
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M02 chrome: breadcrumb from component_stack in status_bar (format_breadcrumb); footer regression tests for major screen families; themes+narrow chrome tests. Evidence: make lint exit 0; cargo test -p andre --test render — 23 passed exit 0. AC-01/02/03 criterion pass stamped.

acceptance_criteria.description: Chrome (breadcrumb + footer + status toggles) renders without panic across themes and degrades on narrow width
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M02 chrome: breadcrumb from component_stack in status_bar (format_breadcrumb); footer regression tests for major screen families; themes+narrow chrome tests. Evidence: make lint exit 0; cargo test -p andre --test render — 23 passed exit 0. AC-01/02/03 criterion pass stamped.

design_decisions.choice: Derive labels from component_stack ids (or Component::id) joined with a separator; top-of-stack only is insufficient
design_decisions.rationale: Status bar previously had no stack awareness; footer already uses top id only for hints.

work_packages.name: Footer regression guard
work_packages.goal: Keep existing context-sensitive footer; add tests, fill only real gaps.

work_packages.name: Location breadcrumb
work_packages.goal: Add component-stack breadcrumb to status bar chrome.

steps.action: Audit existing render_footer: confirm per-screen_id hints + narrow fallback; add/adjust render tests only if gaps found. Do not rewrite footer.
steps.done_when: Footer context behavior is covered by at least one render assertion per major screen family or documented as already covered.

steps.action: Build breadcrumb from component_stack and render it in render_status_bar (or chrome layout); pass stack labels from ui::render.
steps.done_when: After push/pop navigation in a TestBackend draw, buffer contains breadcrumb segments for the stack.

steps.action: Add/extend render tests for themes and narrow width covering breadcrumb + footer; fix any overflow/panic.
steps.done_when: Render suite green; narrow and multi-theme paths covered.

verification.evidence: M02 chrome: breadcrumb from component_stack in status_bar (format_breadcrumb); footer regression tests for major screen families; themes+narrow chrome tests. Evidence: make lint exit 0; cargo test -p andre --test render — 23 passed exit 0. AC-01/02/03 criterion pass stamped.

findings.description: L1 dishonest test: render_app draws into a TestBackend of size WxH but never calls app.set_terminal_size. ui::render gates on ctx.terminal_size (default 80x24), so test_chrome_degrades_on_narrow_width(40,24) still lays out full chrome and is a false green for AC-03 narrow degradation. Fix: set_terminal_size in render_app; split too-small overlay vs min-size chrome assertions.
findings.author: external-reviewer
findings.fixed_in: render tests: set_terminal_size; honest too-small + min-width chrome

findings.description: test_footer_context_hints_per_screen_family covers Main/Group/Settings/Help/Confirm/Execute/Adopt but not UnstowTargetSelect or PackageSelect footer fragments.
findings.author: external-reviewer
findings.fixed_in: render: footer family covers Unstow + PackageSelect
